Who came south with Chandragupta Maurya during the great famine in North India?
x:
According to Jain tradition, a severe famine occurred in North India during the reign of Chandragupta Maurya. The famous Jain monk Bhadrabahu migrated to Shravanabelagola (Karnataka) along with Chandragupta Maurya. Chandragupta is believed to have renounced his throne, accepted Jainism, and finally performed Sallekhana (ritual fasting unto death) at Shravanabelagola. This migration is considered a significant event in the spread of Jainism in South India.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
n: Important for the spread of Jainism in South India.
